test_1_precue_vs_postcue.control_construction: Pre-cue window construction from Commit 7's original test 1 (matched-participant subset; prior_vividness not lagged for precue records -- see honest_limitations note on the discrepancy with test 2's independently-recomputed precue result).
test_1_precue_vs_postcue.description: Pre-cue EEG must not match post-cue predictive performance.
test_1_precue_vs_postcue.decision_rule: corrupted_mean_delta_oos must be near zero (|.| < 0.1) relative to the real post-cue result.
test_1_precue_vs_postcue.scientific_interpretation: Behaves as a valid negative control against real data: the corrupted condition collapses toward the expected null relative to the real result.

test_3_label_shuffle_within_blocks.control_construction: Vividness targets shuffled within each participant, preserving repeated-measures structure.
test_3_label_shuffle_within_blocks.description: Trial labels shuffled within participant must remove the effect.
test_3_label_shuffle_within_blocks.scientific_interpretation: Behaves as a valid negative control against real data: the corrupted condition collapses toward the expected null relative to the real result.

test_6_participant_id_only.control_construction: Neural feature replaced by one random per-participant constant.
test_6_participant_id_only.description: Participant-ID-only features must not explain cross-subject performance.
test_6_participant_id_only.scientific_interpretation: Behaves as a valid negative control against real data: the corrupted condition collapses toward the expected null relative to the real result.

test_8_no_duplicate_stimulus_leakage.control_construction: Structural check: no (participant, session, trial) triple in both train and test of any LOSO fold.
test_8_no_duplicate_stimulus_leakage.description: No (participant, session, trial) triple may appear in both train and test of any fold.
test_8_no_duplicate_stimulus_leakage.decision_rule: No leaked triple may exist in any fold.
test_8_no_duplicate_stimulus_leakage.scientific_interpretation: Behaves as a valid negative control against real data: the corrupted condition collapses toward the expected null relative to the real result.

test_9_hyperparameter_selection_blind_to.control_construction: One isolated LOSO fold's test-side targets corrupted to a fixed value; train-side untouched.
test_9_hyperparameter_selection_blind_to.description: Corrupting only the outer-test targets must leave the selected hyperparameter and trained model checkpoint hash unchanged (both come from train_records only), while the reported test score must change (since it is computed against the corrupted test targets).
test_9_hyperparameter_selection_blind_to.decision_rule: Chosen hyperparameter and checkpoint hash must be unchanged; reported score must change.
test_9_hyperparameter_selection_blind_to.scientific_interpretation: Behaves as a valid negative control against real data: the corrupted condition collapses toward the expected null relative to the real result.

test_10_behavior_plus_random_noise.control_construction: Neural feature vector replaced by independent standard-normal noise of the same dimensionality.
test_10_behavior_plus_random_noise.description: Behavior-plus-random-noise must not reproduce behavior-plus-neural gains.
test_10_behavior_plus_random_noise.decision_rule: corrupted_mean_delta_oos must be near zero and closer to zero than the real result.
test_10_behavior_plus_random_noise.scientific_interpretation: Behaves as a valid negative control against real data: the corrupted condition collapses toward the expected null relative to the real result.

test_2_temporal_shift.control_construction: Two frozen temporal controls over the SAME retained epochs/trials/behavior-only covariates/LOSO folds/inner grid as the primary analysis: (a) pre-cue, the fixation window before perception onset; (b) late-shift, a window one full imagery-phase-duration (4.0s) after the imagery phase's own onset, landing in the post-imagery/inter-trial interval. Only the neural temporal alignment differs.
test_2_temporal_shift.decision_rule: temporal_specificity_supported only if aligned differs materially (paired sign-flip p<0.05, CI excluding zero) from BOTH precue and late-shift. negative_effect_reproduced_by_temporal_control if either temporal control itself shows a comparable significant negative delta_oos and is not significantly different from aligned.
test_2_temporal_shift.scientific_interpretation: negative_effect_reproduced_by_temporal_control. Both temporal controls independently show a significant negative delta_oos of comparable magnitude to aligned (precue: -0.0197, p=0.0002441; late-shift: -0.0247, p=0.004608; aligned: -0.0238, p=0.02499), and neither differs significantly from aligned (aligned-minus-precue p=0.707; aligned-minus-late-shift p=0.892; both CIs include zero). The primary negative effect is NOT specific to genuine imagery-locked neural timing -- it reproduces even in a window before the stimulus was shown. This is evidence against interpreting the primary H2 finding as a temporally-specific neural-content effect.

test_4_random_channel_permutation.control_construction: Channel LABELS deterministically permuted (fixed seed registry, committed before inspection: [101, 202, 303, 404, 505]), then the frozen frontal/central/posterior features recomputed from the SAME retained epochs using the incorrect anatomical mapping. 5 independent permutations, identical nested LOSO analysis for each.
test_4_random_channel_permutation.decision_rule: spatial_specificity_supported only if the correctly-mapped (aligned) delta_oos falls outside the empirical range of the permuted-mapping deltas (an outlier relative to random spatial assignment). A more negative permuted result is NOT automatically a passing/successful control.
test_4_random_channel_permutation.scientific_interpretation: no_spatial_specificity. The correctly-mapped aligned delta_oos (-0.0238) falls WITHIN the empirical range of the 5 permuted-mapping results (-0.0337 to 0.0156), not as an outlier. Scrambling which channels feed the frontal/central/posterior anatomical groups did not reliably destroy or distinguish the negative effect from the correctly-mapped result -- 3/5 permutations produced a similarly negative, and in some cases similarly or more significant, delta_oos. The negative primary effect is not attributable to genuine anatomical/spatial organization of the classical features.

test_5_ocular_frontal_proxy_only.control_construction: Classical features recomputed using ONLY the 7 frozen frontal-proxy channels (FP1,FP2,F7,F3,FZ,F4,F8; YOTO has no dedicated EOG channel), from the identical retained epochs.
test_5_ocular_frontal_proxy_only.decision_rule: frontal_proxy_fully_reproduces_effect if frontal-only delta_oos is statistically indistinguishable from aligned AND of comparable magnitude; frontal_proxy_does_not_reproduce_effect if frontal-only shows no significant effect; frontal_proxy_partially_reproduces_effect if frontal-only shows a significant but substantially smaller effect and the aligned-vs-frontal difference is not clearly significant at conventional thresholds.
test_5_ocular_frontal_proxy_only.scientific_interpretation: frontal_proxy_partially_reproduces_effect. Frontal-proxy-only shows its own significant negative delta_oos (-0.0035, p=0.02396), but roughly 15% of the full aligned magnitude (-0.0238). The aligned-vs-frontal paired difference (mean=-0.0203, sign-flip p=0.0883) is borderline: its bootstrap CI narrowly excludes zero but the sign-flip test does not reach conventional significance. Frontal/ocular-proxy activity contributes a real but partial, not full, share of the primary negative effect -- the mechanism cannot be confidently pinned to posterior/content-related channels alone.

test_7_signal_quality_only.control_construction: Strictly non-content, outcome-independent quality features from the identical retained epochs: peak-to-peak amplitude, broadband/channel-wise variance, spectral flatness, artifact-threshold proximity, missing-channel count, neighboring-trial rejection rate, recording-level retained fraction. No ERP/content/anatomical-group/vividness-derived features.
test_7_signal_quality_only.decision_rule: If signal-quality-only reproduces the negative effect, the correct conclusion is that the result may reflect cross-subject signal-quality heterogeneity rather than absence of neural information -- not a successful neural-content control. Passed here means quality-only did NOT reproduce the effect.
test_7_signal_quality_only.scientific_interpretation: quality_only_does_not_reproduce_effect. Signal-quality-only shows no significant effect on its own (delta_oos=-0.0046, CI=[-0.0255,0.0141], p=0.663), and the aligned-vs-quality difference is not significant (p=0.294). Generic signal-quality heterogeneity across participants does not, on its own, explain the primary negative result -- ruling out this specific confound, even though tests 2 and 4 raise other mechanism concerns (temporal and spatial non-specificity).

summary.note: Tests 2, 4, and 5 raise genuine mechanism concerns (temporal non-specificity, spatial non-specificity, partial frontal-proxy reproduction) that were NOT visible in the original 6/10 real-data battery. Test 7 (signal-quality-only) does not reproduce the effect. The primary numeric result (mean_delta_oos=-0.0238, CI, p=0.025) is unchanged and preserved; see docs/research/C1_FINAL_DECISION.md for the updated gate-decision interpretation (C1_MECHANISM=UNRESOLVED_SIGNAL_QUALITY_OR_ARTIFACT_CONTRIBUTION).

honest_note_on_precue_discrepancy: Test 1 (original Commit 7) computed precue delta_oos on precue TrialRecords that never received add_lagged_prior_vividness() -- meaning their behavior-only covariates always encode has_prior=0, unlike every other analysis in this project. That test 1 precue result (-0.0006) is a much smaller-magnitude, less significant number than test 2 (this session)'s independently-recomputed precue result (-0.0197, p=0.0002), which DOES apply add_lagged_prior_vividness consistently with the primary aligned_full pipeline. Test 2's number is considered the more methodologically consistent one for interpreting temporal specificity (see C1_FINAL_DECISION.md), since every one of its variants -- aligned, precue, late-shift, permuted, frontal, quality -- goes through the identical behavior-only covariate construction, differing ONLY in the neural feature/window. Test 1's original passed=true result is preserved unmodified as historical record, not retroactively corrected, per the instruction not to silently rewrite existing evidence.
